title: WooCommerce derived state and HPOS record counts
steps: Run the real MariaDB WooCommerce database and shell flow cases.
expect: Background-only analytics/admin changes create no backup point.
An HPOS order retains its placeholder and children and counts once.
Placeholder transitions and conflict decisions count the merged record type.
Stable HPOS and legacy compatibility modes count the authoritative order store once.

tests: WooCommerce derived background rows do not create a backup or count as customer changes
WooCommerce HPOS order with a placeholder and child rows is one record with all business data retained
WooCommerce counts use post-type column decisions after merging an independent live title
WooCommerce compatibility copies count the authoritative order once in HPOS and legacy modes
WooCommerce only counts its configured root store while still merging backup changes
